title: Qwen-VL: A Versatile Vision-Language Model for Understanding, Localization, Text Reading, and Beyond
grouping: Three identical columns side by side, one per training stage, each headed by a large serif stage title ('Stage1: Pretraining', …) and footed by a serif line naming its data. Inside each column the same stack repeats from bottom to top: a camera icon with a small resolution label, a ViT block, a thin CrossAttn bar, and a wide language-model block. A 'Learnable Query Embs' label with an arrow enters the CrossAttn bar from the left and a document icon with an up-arrow feeds the language model from the lower right.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin dark outlines, no shadows. Large blocks are filled: lavender-blue when frozen, pale beige/peach when trained; the CrossAttn bar is always a white box with a navy outline. Model names are set very large in serif inside the blocks, other labels small sans. Thin straight black up-arrows connect the stack. Data appear only as black glyph icons (camera, text page), no thumbnails.
proposed_highlight: Training status per stage is the whole message: each block carries a snowflake (frozen) or a flame (trained) beside its name, and the fill colour switches with it (blue frozen, beige trained), so the three columns differ only in which blocks turn blue.
lesson: Show a multi-stage training schedule as the same small stack repeated per stage, changing only each block's fill (blue frozen, beige trained) and its snowflake or flame, so the reader compares stages by colour alone.
notes: Venue: no venue on the PDF or arXiv page (technical report); year = arXiv preprint year. The block fills are embedded raster images in the PDF, so `kb measure` counts them as photo (photo_share 0.776) and its palette omits the blue and beige block fills described above.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: three identical columns left to right, one per training stage (Pretraining, Multi-task Pretraining, Supervised Finetuning), each the same bottom-up stack of camera -> ViT -> CrossAttn -> QwenLM, so the only thing that changes is which blocks are frozen (snowflake, lavender) or trained (flame, beige)

relations.form: within each column thin up-arrows run from the camera icon through ViT and the CrossAttn bar into QwenLM; a document icon with its own up-arrow enters QwenLM from the lower right
the stack is repeated with the same shapes in each column, a stage title above and the data description (Image-Text Pairs; Multi-task and Interleaved VL Data; Chat Interleaved VL Data) below
'Learnable Query Embs' enter the CrossAttn bar from the left as a text label with a short arrow
the image input changes per column by a small text label under the camera icon: Low Resolution in stage 1, High Resolution in stages 2 and 3

channels.colour: block fill = frozen vs trained: lavender-blue with a snowflake = frozen, beige with a flame = trained; the thin CrossAttn bar stays white though always flamed, so the fill code skips it
channels.shape: large rounded boxes = model components, a thin bar = the adapter, black pictograms = data (camera for images, document for text)
channels.frame: no frames; columns are separated by whitespace only

quality.strengths: identical stacks side by side make the stage-to-stage difference (which block freezes, which resolution) the only visible change; the frozen/trained state is double-coded by fill and snowflake/flame icon so it reads instantly; arrows are short and straight
quality.weaknesses: the CrossAttn adapter is a thin white bar although it is trained in all stages, breaking the fill code; the data is only pictograms and small text labels, so no example image or text appears; the columns sit at slightly different heights, weakening the row alignment that the comparison relies on; the resolution change is tiny text under the camera

insights.structure: Three identical columns side by side, one per training stage, each a bottom-to-top stack of camera icon, ViT block, thin CrossAttn bar and wide QwenLM block, headed by a large serif stage title and footed by its data description.
insights.data: Data appear only as black glyphs: a camera with a tiny 'Low/High Resolution' label below the ViT and a document icon with an up-arrow beside the LM; learnable query embeddings enter the CrossAttn bar as a text label from the left.
insights.emphasis: Each block carries a snowflake or flame and switches fill (lavender-blue frozen, beige trained), so the only thing that changes across columns is which blocks freeze.
insights.flow: Thin up-arrows run bottom to top inside each column; columns read left to right as stage 1 to 3.
insights.avoid: Model names are set in a very large serif that dwarfs everything else, and the mixed serif/sans labels look inconsistent.

arrangement.units: three unframed repeated stacks, one per training stage
arrangement.inputs_as: camera icon with resolution label; document icon for text
arrangement.shared: identical block stack and 'Learnable Query Embs' label repeated per column
